main_text.p: unde eam mihi reglutinandi nulla jam-diu reliqua est aut facultas, aut spes. Sed quod amissum est, missum facio; & pergo. Instat tandem destinatus itine-ri dies; et erant quae ad profectionem videbantur necessaria, pleraque expedita: præstolabar tantum tabel-larium hinc cum literis ex quibus non-nulla, quae mihi usui forent, et re-scire intererat, intelligerem. Miror hominem conditio die non adesse: expectio adhuc diem alterum, tertium, quartum; comparet nullus: quinta demum luce venit, sed pedes, inops, squalidus, & mæstus. Nempe acciderat forte per illa tempora, (ip-sissima hac fere anni tempestate,) prælium illud atrox, & utrique parti satis funestum Monticlivense, sive ad Edgehill : unde disjecti sparsique

page.notes: Lower line ends the scan; the page continues on the next leaf. Marks "&" are printed as the ampersand/et sign. "mæstus" and "conditio" read with some doubt because of the ligatures; the spelling is as printed as far as I can read it. No word was illegible.
